label: class_c_04_history_01
text: Greetings, my little students. It is time for our\nmidterm examination.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_04_history_02
text: Summon your historical knowledge from the dark\nrecesses of your minds, and answer the questions.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_04_question_01
text:
1. What is the name of the geological formation
    in the center of the Paldea region?

A) The Great Crater of Paldea
B) The Center of Paldea
C) The Paldean Valley Floor

label: class_c_04_ansewer_01a
text: A) The Great Crater of Paldea

label: class_c_04_question_02
text:
2. What was long believed to rest in the depths
    of Area Zero?

A) A mysterious Pokémon
B) A school
C) Treasure

label: class_c_04_question_03
text:
3. How many years ago did the Paldean Empire
    begin to rule this region?

A) Approximately 1,000 years ago
B) Approximately 2,000 years ago
C) Approximately 3,000 years ago

label: class_c_04_question_04
text:
4. How many years ago was this academy built?

A) 805 years ago
B) 806 years ago
C) 807 years ago

label: class_c_04_question_05a
text:
5. Those seeking __________ need look no further
    than the oranges of Paldea.

A) Power
B) Courage
C) Knowledge

label: class_c_04_question_05b
text:
5. Those seeking __________ need look no further
    than the grapes of Paldea.

A) Power
B) Courage
C) Knowledge

label: class_c_04_history_03
text: Your time is up! Put your writing utensils down![VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_04_history_04
text: That last question was a freebie. Even the least\ncapable of you surely padded your score there.\r\nI sincerely hope you did, anyway.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_04_history_05
text: So ends our midterm examination. You may ask\nfor your scores at the school’s front desk.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
